Marissa - per your ask, sending a concise ballpark model back here. I kept assumptions conservative; happy to adjust after a short sync.

Assumptions (high level):
- Model profile: RedRef-3xx family equivalent (medium context workloads).
- Avg tokens per inference (roundtrip): 120 tokens.
- Pilot volume: 20M tokens/month; Peak volume: 140M tokens/month.
- Target p95 latency budget: 200-250ms (fits Dedicated sizing below).

1) Hosted (pay-as-you-go per-token) - ballpark
- Price: $0.0009 / 1K tokens (i.e., $0.0000009 per token) - for clarity we'll present per-1K in collateral.
- Pilot (20M tokens): ~ $18/month. (20,000 * $0.0009 = $18)
- Peak (140M tokens): ~ $126/month.
- Notes: Good for low-commit pilots, predictable unit costs but no reserved SLA for tail latency. Enterprise tiers and priority routing may add fixed fees.

2) Dedicated (reserved capacity) - ballpark monthly commit model
- Option A: 1x reserved node pool (approx equates to sustained ~150 qps with batching)
  - Monthly commit: ~$18,000/month (3-month or annual term pricing varies).
  - Effective cost per million tokens (at 140M tokens): ~$128/month per 1M tokens (this is a rough normalization including idle capacity benefit during spikes).
- Option B: 2x reserved node pool (for headroom during spikes; better p95)
  - Monthly commit: ~$32,000/month.
  - Effective cost per million tokens (at 140M tokens): ~$229 / 1M tokens.
- Notes: Dedicated gives much better p95 and predictable throughput; good fit if you need tight latency SLO during promos. These numbers assume typical batching and our prefix cache; actual pricing will depend on exact qps distribution and chosen VM/GPU type.

3) Private/VPC / On-prem - ballpark
- Private VPC (managed control plane + customer VPC): one-time setup ~ $7k, then platform fee ~$6k/month + infra costs.
- On-prem (air-gapped): licenses + install (~$120k one-time) + recommended infra: 2x A100-equivalent hosts for HA (~$40k-$80k hardware + ops). Lead time: 6-10 weeks for on-prem packaging and validation; VPC typically 2-4 weeks.

Attachments: Redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf (detailed committed tier guidance)
Shared calc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAtlasRetailSales (editable)

Quick guidance for Sam/Priya to decide:
- Pilot: Hosted pay-as-you-go keeps CapEx near zero and lets you test for <$50/month.
- If you need tight p95 through promos and predictable monthly billing, Dedicated 1x reserved node (~$18k/month) is a practical starting point; 2x for larger headroom.
- Private/on-prem only if you have strong compliance or data residency constraints not addressable by VPC.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk the calc with you both.
